ns2:course.label: Econ of Consumption
ns2:course.description: (ACE 374) Concepts, theories, and methods for analysis of the micro and macro aspects of consumption; includes standards and content of consumption and description of consumption patterns and trends in the USA and selected other countries. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ECON 101, or ECON 102 and ECON 103, or ACE 100; a course in statistics; junior standing.
